body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a critical navigation issue where 4 of 6 navigation modes (page, new_window, split, popover) were non-functional when clicking ListView rows. Only drawer and modal modes worked previously.

**Changes:**
- Enhanced `useNavigationOverlay` hook to delegate `new_window` actions to `onNavigate` callback when available, allowing app-layer URL construction
- Added `split` and `popover` branches to plugin-view's `handleRowClick` to properly trigger overlay state
- Implemented fallback Dialog rendering in `NavigationOverlay` for popover mode when no `popoverTrigger` is provided
- Restructured Console ObjectView to conditionally render split layout with `mainContent` wrapper around main view
- Updated Console's `onNavigate` callbacks to handle both page navigation (via React Router) and new_window actions (via window.open with correct URLs)
- Added comprehensive test coverage for all navigation modes across 4 test files

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts` | Added delegation to `onNavigate` for new_window mode when callback is available |
| `packages/react/src/__tests__/useNavigationOverlay.test.ts` | Added tests for new_window delegation with and without `onNavigate` callback |
| `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` | Added split and popover branches to `handleRowClick` to trigger form display |
| `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.test.tsx` | Added tests verifying split and popover modes open form in view mode |
| `packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx` | Added fallback Dialog rendering for popover mode when no trigger element exists |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/navigation-overlay.test.tsx` | Added tests for popover fallback Dialog behavior |
| `apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx` | Implemented page/new_window navigation logic in `onNavigate`, restructured JSX to render split layout conditionally with `mainContent` |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/ObjectView.test.tsx` | Added integration tests for page, new_window, split, and popover navigation modes with click-through verification |
| `ROADMAP.md` | Documented the navigation mode fix and implementation details |
</details>
